subject: Case study request: Amply Health + Redwood Inference — use of logo & customer quote
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@amplyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Case study request: Amply Health + Redwood Inference — use of logo & customer quote

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the close partnership on the recent pilot. We put together a short draft case study (attached) that highlights the joint work on latency optimization and the cost savings Amply saw in production. Would Amply be open to: 

- A short customer spotlight on our site featuring Amply Health logo (lockup) and a 1–2 sentence quote from your team
- A brief landing hero (logo + headline + pull-quote) and a downloadable PDF case brief

Attached: redwood_case_draft-v1.docx (we’ve kept technical detail light; quote is marked with [QUOTE_CANDIDATE]).

If you’re ok in principle, what does the approval path look like on your side? We can accept legal redlines and are happy to route to marketing for final logo assets. Suggested timeline: publish late April if approvals align.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior GTM Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Attachment: redwood_case_draft-v1.docx
From: Amply Health Legal <legal@amplyhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@amplyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:23:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Case study request: Amply Health + Redwood Inference — use of logo & customer quote

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for sending the draft. We’re generally fine with customer spotlights but need to run this through Legal and Marketing for a standard review. A few items up front:

1) Please remove any patient-level or PHI examples (the draft appears OK but flagging for confirmation).
2) We will provide a redline to the document with a few edits to the proposed quote and timeline.
3) Amply’s logo usage must follow our brand lockup rules — see linked guidelines below.

I’ve attached the redline (redwood_case_draft-redlines-amply.docx). Priya from our marketing team is copied and will handle the final art approvals. Once we have Marketing sign-off and a Legal review completed, we can provide the approved PNG/SVG and a signed consent PDF if that’s required.

Cheers,

Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships
Amply Health
samir.patel@amplyhealth.com

Attachment: redwood_case_draft-redlines-amply.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Amply redlines — request for product/comms review

Marissa / Laura — forwarding Amply’s redlines and note from Samir. Quick summary and ask: 

- Legal requested removal/confirmation about PHI (our draft is already anonymized but ask Eng to confirm no telemetry snippets remain).
- Marketing will require logo lockup per their guidelines; they’ll supply assets once approved.
- Priya will own final sign-off from Amply marketing; Samir said Legal will provide a signed consent PDF.

Can we: 
1) Marissa — confirm the two pull-quote candidates in the doc are okay as edited by Amply, or suggest tighter wording; I’ve attached v2 with our proposed reply edits (redwood_case_draft-v2.docx).
2) Laura — quick compliance check to confirm doc contains no identifying telemetry or logs before we return to Amply.

If both thumbs-up, I’ll send the updated doc back to Priya and Samir asking for final assets and consent. Target: finalize by EOD Thu so we can publish next week.

Thanks —
Rishi

Hi Rishi and Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Amply Marketing has reviewed redwood_case_draft-v2 and we can confirm the following approvals: 

- Amply Health grants permission for Redwood Inference to publish the case study and to use the Amply Health logo lockup in the formats outlined (PNG/SVG).
- Approved pull-quote: "Redwood’s inference optimizations reduced our tail latency and lowered per-request costs, enabling a better patient experience at scale." (attribution: Rajesh Menon, CTO) — you may shorten to the 1–2 sentence variant in our redline.
- We confirm there is no PHI present in the revised draft.
- Attached: amply_logo_lockup.png and amply_signed-consent.pdf (signed by Amply legal).

Brand guidelines: https://amplyhealth.com/brand-guidelines/logos (please do not alter clearspace or colors).

Please let me know once the final PDF is ready and we’ll coordinate a joint publish date. Looking forward to seeing the final asset.

Best,

Priya Desai
Sr. Manager, Brand & Communications
Amply Health
priya.desai@amplyhealth.com
